name: Singapore

supply.note: Four National Taps, confirmed by PUB. Shares are withheld under Rule 9.5: installed capacity is not production. PUB has not published an annual production mix with a year attached.

grade_note: Grade B. Every input is established from a published primary source. The one open question is the rounding stage of the Water Conservation Tax — the official rule gives 0.715, PUB's own table prints 0.72, and the two produce bills S$ 0.08 apart. That is one field in a public PDF, not a missing document.

sources_by_metric._note: All five documents bear on both metrics: the release sets all three rates, IRAS sets the tax, and the SP documents give currency and the billing formula.

open_items: Read the Water Conservation Tax rate field in SP's published sample bill. Four decimal places are printed there; either 0.7150 or 0.7200 closes the question and lifts the city to Grade A.
A private SP Services invoice is now an independent reconciliation, as in Dubai, rather than a prerequisite.
basket_note: Grade B, so outside the UWTI base basket, which admits Grade A constituents only.
